hypothesis: Removing additive training output noise may prevent the clean learned-MoG native distribution from contracting late. This is a one-factor diagnostic of the training/scoring-law mismatch, not a predicted positive or a full-reference claim.
changed_factors: Remove training output-noise convolution in both discriminator and generator objectives: output_noise_std 0.029 -> 0.0. Preserve clean public sampling, A2, all other resolved recipe fields, seed, initializer, prior and full gates.
mechanism_rationale: Remove a stochastic convolution from the trained fake distribution using an existing public Recipe field. This changes the training objective while retaining the declared evaluation law; it is neither a constant search nor a sampling-only patch. Zero means absence of this mechanism, not a tuned noise amplitude.
